name: Clean old build files

# Run this by hand: Actions > "Clean old build files" > Run workflow.
# It deletes ALL stored build artifacts (APK zips) of this repository to free the Actions storage.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  actions: write

jobs:
  clean:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Delete all artifacts
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          ids=$(gh api --paginate "repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/artifacts?per_page=100" --jq '.artifacts[].id')
          count=0
          for id in $ids; do
            gh api -X DELETE "repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/artifacts/$id" > /dev/null && count=$((count+1))
          done
          echo "Deleted $count artifacts."
